text:
maria: heads up — after the kernel-autoswitch rollout at 18:03 UTC p99 for model x-13 jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.6s. canary-2 showed the same spike before it hit prod. p95 looks okay, tail exploded. anyone seeing logs?
ops-bot: :rotating_light: alert high_latency_detected model=x-13 p99=1600ms p95=260ms traffic=1.2k rps — triggered by rollout rl-2026-345
jin: grabbing logs now. can someone run the selector debug dump? e.g.
```
kubectl exec -it $(kubectl get pods -l pool=canary-2 -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -c runtime -- /bin/sh -c 'cat /proc/kernel_selector/debug'
```
liam: quick read — kernel selector flipped smallseq paths to `fused-quantized-v2` after it saw microbatch_mean drop < 8. prefetch hit rate fell from 0.12 -> 0.02 and kvcache miss rate spiked. looks like fused-quantized-v2 has higher per-request latency for tiny seqs (extra kernel launches).
sam: can we pin the canary pool back to `fused-quantized-v1` while we investigate? sample patch: 
```
pool: canary-2
update: 
  kernel_selector:
    mode: pinned
    value: fused-quantized-v1
```
anita: did that for canary-2 at 18:12 UTC — p99 fell back to ~240ms within 30s. rolling a rollback to prod now. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: rollback queued: rollout_id=rl-2026-345 revert_to=rl-2026-320 ETA=120s
maria: prod after rollback p99=230ms p95=250ms. incident mitigated. initial hypothesis: autoswitch heuristic too aggressive when workload skewed to small sequences combined with aggressive prefetch eviction. need a postmortem.
jin: capturing perf + nvtx traces and will produce flamegraphs. early profiler shows extra kernel launch overhead and increased memcpy activity in fused-quantized-v2 for <16-token sequences. command I'm running: `nvprof --metrics gld_efficiency -- /opt/runtime/bin/infer --trace`
liam: propose a guard: do not autoswitch to fused kernels when smallseq_ratio > 0.6 AND prefetch_hit < 0.1. also gate autoswitch by tail metrics (p99) not just mean. will open a PR for the selector with a canary gate.
maria: agreed. I'll file an RFC and a follow-up ticket for: selector heuristics, prefetch eviction tuning, and a canary gating rule for tail-aware decisions. thanks everyone for the quick revert.
sam: note for postmortem: add synthetic smallseq load test to our perf-suite so we catch this before rollouts.
